plans.idea: Message-first column: a centred logo, then a tall text block so the headline, the three flavours and the copy are readable, then the hero bag with the two other bags as a small lineup beneath it, and the Build Your Pack button full-width at the bottom.

Product-first column like the original: the logo on top, a large hero bag with the two other bags grouped right under it as a lineup, then the headline and flavour copy, and the button closing the column.
Hero-led poster with a brand sign-off: the bag fills the top, the text block follows, the button and the small bag lineup sit together as the action zone, and the logo signs off at the very bottom.
